question: Учитывая весь текущий evidence packet, какой один следующий физически проверяемый класс места/объекта следует проверять первым в поиске предполагаемой реликвии Осириса? Ответ должен быть исследовательской приоритизацией, не сверхъестественным утверждением.

late_literary: Plutarch: phallus not recovered, river/fish branch, replica made
Plutarch: Isis also preserves decoy/effigy burial strategy so Typhon cannot identify true tomb
Diodorus: multiple priestly burial claims and images; privates said to be thrown into Nile by Typhon; likeness made
egyptian_ritual_geography: Khoiak traditions include finding/reconstitution of phallus on ritual days
Papyrus Brooklyn 47.218.84 / Mendesian tradition links divine flesh with phallus and spine/back
Mendes/Djedet/Tell el-Ruba is therefore a high-value phallus-specific locality
Abydos remains major Osirian cult/control locality
custody_and_protection: BD17: Anubis guards a chest containing Osirian entrails
BD151: Qebehsenuef protects/reassembles Osiris; Duamutef rescues father Osiris
BD42: phallus explicitly identified with Osiris but no phallus-specific guardian named
Sobek has source-bound water-recovery competence in BD113 but phallus-specific tasking is unresolved
No evidence Isis deliberately misled Sobek
functional_restoration: Physical phallus loss does not equal loss of generative function in the mythic/theological graph
Postmortem conception traditions coexist with missing-phallus/replica traditions
Original and ritual substitute could theoretically occupy different custody branches; this remains a hypothesis

mendes_1902: Quibell 1902 documents gold funerary body-part sheaths including a phallus sheath in Nesbanebdjedet burial at Mendes
Nesbanebdjedet held an explicit Osirian priestly title: Prophet of Osiris in Anpet
Original burial assemblage suffered documented unauthorized removal before official recovery
The Met links gold funerary equipment from this burial to Cairo CG 53465-53469
Exact CG number corresponding to the phallus sheath remains unresolved
gold_and_substitute_controls: Met 23.10.23: gold-sheet phallus(?) amulet from Saqqara/Memphite context; form control, not Osiris relic
Cairo JE 56935 and JE 56967 are gold penis/phallus amulet records; detailed metrology still needed
Real Egyptian mummies can preserve biological genitalia plus a separate ritual genital model, so duplicate does not prove absence of original
modular_osiris_and_terracotta: KHM Osiris object has penis and testicles separately made and inserted into an oval recess
BM 1973,0501.23: separate hand-modelled terracotta insert phallus, 6.60 x 1.70 cm; internal hollow/solid state unknown
BM 1973,0501.45: separately made hollow two-piece moulded inserted phallus
BM 1973,0501.53: socket remains after phallus loss
Current audited terracotta corpus: 33 records; serial mould production and detachable phallus technology supported
Strong dimensional near-match: BM 1973,0501.22 vs Louvre E35618, but axis semantics are not yet homologous enough for same-mould claim
female_mirror_control: Egyptian material culture includes female genital/fertility symbolism including cowrie/vulva associations
Mendes has female divine/fertility material context, but no Mendes gold vulva object has yet been identified
Hidden-female Osiris/Seth theory is currently contradicted by the textual gender model and remains a falsification branch, not an admitted conclusion

archaeological_container_controls: Hollow sacred objects and sealed openings can preserve internal contents
Anubis-associated shrine/jar hidden in wall chamber at Lisht is a positive control for sacred object + nested container + hidden chamber architecture, not an Osiris-phallus claim
Relevant non-destructive classes: sealed cavity, hollow statuette, reliquary vessel, internal compartment, resin-linen packet, nested container, sealed bronze/wood opening

current_ranked_localities.reason: phallus-specific Egyptian ritual geography + Osirian priest burial + gold phallus sheath + incomplete assemblage
major Osirian cult and burial/relic tradition
gold phallic amulet control + Osirian/Sokar funerary context
dense detachable/moulded terracotta phallus corpus, not direct Osiris provenance

current_blockers: Obtain dimensions/photos/conservation records for Mendes 1902 gold phallus sheath
Check radiography/micro-CT for BM 1973,0501.23 damaged root and internal structure
Obtain calibrated 3D metrology for strongest terracotta near-match
Search catalogues without the word phallus: ritual substitute, amulet, votive, insert, unidentified fragment, body-part symbol, reliquary, packet

blind_aura_previous_result.direct_seed: First inspect an object catalogued as ritual substitute, amulet or symbol rather than anatomical detail; the target may survive under a functional rather than literal name.

requested_output.format: one primary target plus three supporting cards
